stories.title: Show HN: FeralHq – The funniest AI driven content generation engine
stories.summary: So I really love building apps. If you dig through my post history, you’ll find a small graveyard of launches to prove it.Marketing(or marketers) and I, however, have never gotten along. I can build the product. Writing the "look at me, I made a thing" post has always felt stressful and a little nauseating.So I built FeralHq.Feral is an agentic system for generating social media content for brands, but with a very specific goal: make the output actually funny. I built it primarily to solve my own problem of posting content on social media.And because this is HN, here are the technical specs:Feral has three main agentic workflows:1. Brand Context: give it your URL and it crawls the site, builds a structured brand profile, and figures out what you sell, who it’s for, and what kind of content fits.2.
